messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["lion", "leopard", "eagle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a large upright chimera rearing on two powerful hind legs, with a tawny lion-like head and full shaggy mane, a neck and upper chest covered in overlapping brown feathers, two broad outstretched feathered wings on its sides, a lean torso and limbs covered in dark rosette spots on tan fur, and a long slender spotted tail ending in a dark tuft.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a tawny lion head with yellow eyes, dark nose and white muzzle", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded lion ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the sides of the head beneath the mane"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy tawny-brown lion mane", "part": "mane", "where": "encircling the head and hanging over the neck"}, {"looks_like": "broad brown feathered bird wings with layered coverts and long flight feathers", "part": "wings", "where": "extending outward from the sides of the upper chest"}, {"looks_like": "muscular spotted feline hind legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the lower torso supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "large feline paws with short claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the two legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "a long slender spotted tail with a dark fluffy tuft", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear and curving to the left"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping brown leaf-shaped feathers", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the neck and upper chest"}, {"looks_like": "dark brown rosette spots on a tan background", "part": "markings", "where": "covering the torso, legs and tail"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
